layers.CUT_OUTSIDE: Profile cut, OUTSIDE the line, through 18 mm (add tabs)
layers.CUT_NESTED: Small parts nested inside a window: cut OUTSIDE the line, BEFORE CUT_INSIDE (add tabs)
layers.CUT_INSIDE: Profile cut, INSIDE the line, through 18 mm (windows, holes, slots, letters)
layers.CUT_DOOR: Door openings: cut ON the line, through — the loose piece becomes the door
layers.DRILL_7: Drill 7 mm through (confirmat screw shank holes)
layers.DRILL_10: Drill 10 mm through (M8 T-nuts / bolts / levelling feet)
layers.ENGRAVE_V: V-bit engrave 3 mm deep, 60/90 deg (decoration, text)
layers.SHEET: Sheet outline 1220 x 2440 — do not cut
